from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
counter = 0
def report(o):
    p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print({k:v for k,v in o.meta.items() if k not in ['proprio','cameras']}, flush=True)
    print('ee',p[14:28], 'tcp',p[56:70], 'opening',p[[36,43]],flush=True)
def locate(o,cam='head_camera'):
    rgb=o.last[cam].astype(float); d=o.depth[cam].astype(float)
    c=o.meta['cameras'][cam]; K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); M=np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
    v,u=np.indices(d.shape)
    pc=np.stack([(u-K[0,2])*d/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*d/K[1,1], -d],-1)
    pw=pc@M[:3,:3].T+M[:3,3]
    positions={}
    for i,name in enumerate(['red','green','blue']):
        mask=(rgb[:,:,i]>80)&(rgb[:,:,i]>1.6*rgb[:,:,(i+1)%3])&(rgb[:,:,i]>1.6*rgb[:,:,(i+2)%3])&(d>0)
        points=pw[mask]
        if not len(points): continue
        z=np.percentile(points[:,2],90); top=points[points[:,2]>z-.003]
        center=(top.min(0)+top.max(0))/2
        print(name,'n',len(points),'center top',center,'bounds',np.percentile(points,[0,100],axis=0),flush=True)
        positions[name]=center
    return positions

def move(arm, xyz, grip, q=None, note=''):
    global obs,counter
    p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']); a=np.r_[p[14:21],p[28],p[21:28],p[29]]
    j=0 if arm=='left' else 8
    if q is None: q=[.70710678,0,.70710678,0]
    rot=Rotation.from_quat(np.array(q)[[1,2,3,0]]).as_matrix()
    a[j:j+3]=np.array(xyz)-.12*rot[:,0]; a[j+3:j+7]=q; a[j+7]=grip
    obs=r.submit('ee_pose',[a],include_depth=True,video='mp4',note=note)
    counter+=1; obs.save(f'/app/output/step{counter:02d}'); report(obs)
    return obs

def watch(t=.6):
    global obs,counter
    obs=r.get_obs(seconds=t,include_depth=True); counter+=1; obs.save(f'/app/output/step{counter:02d}'); report(obs)
PY"}));
